services.title: Foreign Credential Evaluation
services.intro: Professional evaluation of international educational credentials for employment, immigration, and education purposes in the United States.
services.whatText: Foreign Credential Evaluation is a service provided by professional evaluation agencies to evaluate educational backgrounds, test scores, and professional experiences obtained outside the United States. It's essential for foreign nationals seeking work authorization (H1B), immigration status, employment, education, and other purposes in the US.
services.documentText: Basic evaluation that includes U.S. degree equivalency only. Often satisfies requirements for employment and immigration.
services.courseText: Complete report including U.S. degree equivalency, credits, grades, and GPA. Recommended for college admission, licensing, and USCIS RFE.
services.expertText: Pairs relevant professional experience with academic coursework to determine U.S. degree equivalency.
services.certifiedText: Certified / Notarized Translation. Used for: USCIS / Colleges / DMV etc.
services.interpretationText: Professional Interpretation covers most metropolitan areas.
services.technicalText: Including Scientific / Industrial / Medical / Business / Legal / Education Translation.

preEvaluation.title: Pre-Evaluation Services
preEvaluation.question: Not sure what your foreign degree is equivalent to in the U.S.?
preEvaluation.intro: Our comprehensive pre-evaluation service provides instant insights about your educational qualifications, helping you understand how your international credentials translate in the American education system.
preEvaluation.instantText: Get immediate preliminary evaluation of your degree equivalency
preEvaluation.affordableText: Affordable preliminary evaluation for the price of two burgers
preEvaluation.guidanceText: Expert advice on next steps for credential evaluation
preEvaluation.closing: Our pre-evaluation tool helps you understand your educational background before proceeding with formal credential evaluation, saving you time and providing valuable insights for your academic or professional journey in the United States.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Which evaluation is right for me?
faq.a1: A document-by-document evaluation provides a U.S. degree equivalency and is often used for employment or immigration. A course-by-course evaluation also includes credits, grades, and GPA, and is commonly requested for education or licensing. Always confirm the requirements with the organization receiving your report.
faq.q2: How long does a credential evaluation take?
faq.a2: Standard document-by-document evaluation takes {days} business days. Other evaluation types have different timelines, and expedited options are available. Contact our team to confirm the timeline for your documents and service.
faq.q3: Can I start my application online?
faq.a3: Yes. Use Apply Now to access our existing online application portal. You can also contact our team for guidance on the service and documents you need.
faq.q4: What languages do you work with?
faq.a4: We offer over 100 language pairs, including English, Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Russian, Arabic, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, and Korean. Contact us to confirm availability for your documents.
